event: Core hydrogen exhausted; Sun leaves the main sequence
notes: 5 Gyr absolute. Fusion moves to a shell around an inert helium core.

event: RGB ascent begins; envelope inflates as the H shell burns
notes: Core contracts under electron degeneracy. Pressure there no longer depends on temperature.
Planets drifting outward as the Sun sheds mass, but not fast enough.

event: Venus engulfed; Sun approaching 1 AU in radius
AI-1 forecasts the moment of ignition
notes: The star is late by 11400 yr.

event: Sun near maximum extent: 2730 L-sun, 256 R-sun, 2600 K
notes: Schroder & Smith 2008. Largest the Sun ever gets. The AGB will be brighter but hotter and therefore smaller (~200 R-sun).
Race between mass-loss orbital expansion and tidal drag. Schroder & Smith say engulfed; Nordhaus 2010 says survives. An engulfed Earth spirals to the core and is destroyed in ~3000 yr.
Helium flash. Three He-4 to C-12.

event: Runaway: no thermostat in degenerate gas
notes: Pressure is set by electron degeneracy, not temperature, so heating causes no expansion. Triple-alpha rate scales as ~T^40.

event: Peak output ~10^11 L-sun, comparable to a galaxy
notes: Entirely absorbed by the overlying envelope. Nothing escapes. The most violent event in the Sun's life is invisible from outside.

event: Degeneracy lifted in the ignition shell; core expands and cools
Neutrinos reach the detector shell at 60 AU
notes: Thermal signal prompt and faint; fluorine-18 signal strong and smeared over hours. Ignition placed 40 degrees off the rotation axis.

event: First surface sign: a change in the star's slow pulse
Star has shrunk and dimmed to a few tens of L-sun
notes: From outside, the flash looks like relief.
At 2730 L-sun, Earth-strength sunlight fell at 52 AU. The only summer the outer system had.

event: Five subflashes, each deeper and weaker
notes: Subflashes are from models (Bildsten et al. 2012); the count of five is invented.

event: Centre burns helium steadily; flash complete
Horizontal branch: quiet core helium burning throughout
notes: The reprieve, arriving after everything inside 1.2 AU is already destroyed.
